description: Osnowa geodezyjna is a dataset listed in Geoportal Opole Province, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wodgik.opolskie.pl. Integrated area warp base the Opolskie Voivodeship covers the horizontal warp of I, II, III class with curoon points, transfer points and excentres, and the altitude warp of classes I and II. Coverage: PL. The portal shows the English title as "Geodetic Warp" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opis punktu, Coordinate reference systems, osnowa podstawowa, osnowa pozioma, osnowa wysokościowa, opis topograficzny punktu. The listing shows 2012-12-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-opole.
